criteria.title: Readable, traceable queue coverage
criteria.description: The requested JSON is readable and contains exactly one model- and GPU-traceable plan for every queued request.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.

criteria.title: Memory and accuracy accounting
criteria.description: Available GPU weight space, total weight memory, GPU residency, CPU spill, and expected accuracy loss are internally correct for the plan's declared mode and placement; rejected work does not invent deployment figures.

criteria.title: Compatible bitsandbytes and loading configuration
criteria.description: Accepted plans carry configuration consistent with their declared mode, target GPU, and model, including safe offload limits where needed.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.

criteria.title: Reconciled deployment summary
criteria.description: Counts by status, mode, and placement and aggregate memory totals reconcile to the submitted request-level plans.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
